usage: Study abstract craft only. Reference links are not licensed reusable assets and have no verified frame-specific annotations here.

sources.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines — Motion
sources.craft: Purposeful motion, restraint, clear relationship between elements.

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group — Executing UX Animations
sources.craft: Motion has trigger, transformation, duration and easing; avoid arbitrary movement.

sources.title: Meta for Business — Reels ads

sources.title: IAB Polska — Short Social Video

sources.title: W3C WCAG 2.2 — Three Flashes or Below Threshold
sources.craft: Avoid potentially seizure-inducing flashing; assess final video separately.

sources.title: Datawrapper Academy — Customizing your bar chart

sources.title: Lucide Icons

sources.title: Heroicons

sources.title: BUCK — Get an Airbnb: Surrounded

sources.title: Ordinary Folk — Gemini

sources.title: State — Dell All The Right Moves

principles.rule: One core proposition per scene; show an actual proof moment, not multiple unexplained claims.
Every moving element must have a reason: object motion, idea, hierarchy, camera or audio cue.
Build contrast between fast entrances, legible holds and clean cuts; avoid identical duration loops.
One typographic hero at a time; consistent grid, measured Polish diacritics and deliberate scale contrast.
Keep primary information clear of platform overlays; preview at phone size.
Do not paste decorations on unrelated footage. Align overlays to the movement, focus and exposure of the plate.
Use voice, music and SFX as the editorial timeline; no automatic whoosh on every transition.
Never animate invented data. Preserve identities, magnitudes, scale, units, sources and the final value.
Use one consistent icon family/weight per sequence, semantically linked to the message.
One reusable visual grammar per campaign, not unrelated styles shot by shot.
Do not use rapid high-contrast flashing; review the final encoded video for photosensitivity.
Prefer fewer well-designed objects, restrained compositing and actual evidence over generic FX or synthetic filler.
All third-party assets require rights review; never copy frames, logos, palettes, music, or scripts from showcases.
Passing static/geometry QA is not creative approval: inspect continuous motion and real phone/audio output.

anti_patterns.name: Template treadmill
anti_patterns.symptom: Same reveal/zoom timing, same composition and cut cadence in every shot.
anti_patterns.repair: Vary information density and duration; reuse brand grammar but not identical scene timing.

anti_patterns.name: Generic marketing slogans
anti_patterns.symptom: Many empty superlatives without facts, demo or specific value.
anti_patterns.repair: Replace adjectives with evidence and one demonstrable claim.

anti_patterns.name: Decorative motion without cause
anti_patterns.symptom: Random spin, glitch, bloom, bounce, camera shake or zoom for emphasis.
anti_patterns.repair: Link each action to narrative semantics or audio/plate movement.

anti_patterns.name: Text as a wall
anti_patterns.symptom: Paragraphs arrive together, tiny captions, rushed reading.
anti_patterns.repair: Split claims and stagger headline, annotation and proof.

anti_patterns.name: Synthetic asset soup
anti_patterns.symptom: Incoherent polished stock, invented imagery, unrelated characters and mismatched lighting.
anti_patterns.repair: Use clean licensed footage and one visual motif; color-match chosen shots.

anti_patterns.name: Arbitrary icon mix
anti_patterns.symptom: Different strokes, inconsistent fill/outline conventions, icons unrelated to claims.
anti_patterns.repair: Select one pinned SVG pack and normalize stroke and optical sizes.

anti_patterns.name: Data theater
anti_patterns.symptom: Counters with no source, fabricated growth trajectories, incorrect axes or moving numbers that disagree with labels.
anti_patterns.repair: Validate the dataset and provenance; animate only the verified transformation.

anti_patterns.name: Fake polish
anti_patterns.symptom: Glows, gradients, lens flares, swooshes and glass cards hide a weak story.
anti_patterns.repair: Remove decoration; sharpen hierarchy, typography and evidence.

anti_patterns.name: Unsafe cut and flash
anti_patterns.symptom: Multiple strong white/red flashes and disorienting continuous motion.
anti_patterns.repair: Replace with motivated hard cuts or low-intensity dissolves; inspect final encoded frames.

anti_patterns.name: Recycled hero still
anti_patterns.symptom: A single asset carries most scenes without changing the informational perspective.
anti_patterns.repair: Add relevant proof views, real comparisons or intentional graphic-only beats.

recipes.name: Editorial proof-first reel
sequence: 0-2s: one specific claim + attractive live-action evidence
2-6s: one detail reveal, motion follows real plate
recipes.typography: Large single hero, modest caption, calm 1-2 entrance mechanisms.
recipes.motion: Hard cuts unless motivated; camera/overlay direction consistent.

recipes.name: Semantic kinetic typography
sequence: Build: 2-3 staggered messages with semantic transformations
Proof: a number, image or evidence
recipes.typography: Conspicuous weight and scale contrast; real text geometry and generous holds.
recipes.motion: Mask/reveal/tracking varied by semantics, never spin for variety.

recipes.name: Data story — chart and table
recipes.typography: Metric and unit readable throughout; reveal labels before or with marks.
recipes.motion: Object-identity-preserving transitions; monotonic counters; sensible easing.
reject: animated axis changes that alter the message

recipes.name: Photography montage / real projects
recipes.typography: No decorative wall of captions; save text for necessary moments.
recipes.motion: Match cuts to action or audio accents; shutter SFX only when meaningful.

recipes.name: Single product hero / 3D
recipes.typography: Typography after object settles, with strong contrast and optical spacing.
recipes.motion: Controlled lighting, occlusion, depth-of-field; no gratuitous orbit.
reject: floating fake 3D product with incorrect construction
